description: Execute KQL against a Reflex's activation records. Each query statement produces one table in source-text order.
notes: Rows are positional arrays aligned with columns. Standard KQL data queries, explicit union queries, .show tables, and .show table <name> cslschema are supported. Wildcard union * is not supported. Query text is limited to 1,048,576 characters and may time out after approximately 30 seconds.
